members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity, such as an ISO date. A candle whose key survives a data change slides to its new place instead of redrawing.

members.name: label
members.doc: Full label for the tooltip and screen readers, such as "Tue, Nov 10".

members.name: axisLabel
members.doc: Short label under the candle, such as "Nov 10". Leave it out on most candles to keep the axis quiet.

members.name: open
members.doc: Price at the start of the period.

members.name: close
members.doc: Price at the end of the period.

members.name: volume
members.doc: Optional traded volume, shown in the tooltip.

types.name: CandlestickChartProps
types.doc: Use a candlestick chart for open, high, low and close prices over a run of periods.

members.name: data
members.doc: Candles in time order, oldest first.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is priced, such as "Northwind Corp." Names the chart for assistive technology and heads the readout.

members.name: period
members.doc: The range on show, such as "Last 30 sessions". It rests beside the change.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats prices on the axis, in the header and in the tooltip.

members.name: formatVolume
members.doc: Formats the optional volume in the tooltip.

members.name: hideHeader
members.doc: Hides the headline with the last price and the change over the range.

members.name: activeIndex
members.doc: Controlled index of the candle under the crosshair, or null for none.

members.name: defaultActiveIndex
members.doc: Candle under the crosshair on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.doc: Called when the crosshair moves to another candle or leaves the plot.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
